spans.s:
पियारु पियारु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. the Sautra rt.
1. पीय्), Ved. censuring, blaming, deriding, mis-
chievous (Sāy. = हिंसक).

पियाल पियाल, अस्, m. (= प्रियाल, q. v.,
but said to be fr. the Sautra rt. 1. पीय्), the tree
Buchanania Latifolia (called in Hindī also Chironji,
whence it has been named Chironjia Sapida; in
Bengal it is commonly called Piya or Piyal); (अम्),
n. the fruit of Buchanania Latifolia.

पीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being drunk or quaffed,
being drunk or sucked in.

1. पीयूष, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be fr. the
Sautra rt. 1. पीय्), the first milk given by a cow
after calving, biestings; the milk of a cow during
the first seven days after calving; any thick fluid,
cream, juice (Sāy. = रस-भूतम् पयः, अभिन-
वम् पयः); the drink of immortality produced at
the churning of the ocean of milk, the food of the
gods, ambrosia, nectar; milk; [cf. पेयूष.]
—पी-
यूष-महस्, आस्, or पीयूष-रुचि, इस्, m. ‘bright
with nectar,’ the moon (whose rays are said to be
filled with nectar).
—पीयूष-वर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्,
milk-white, white as milk.
—पीयूष-वर्ष, अस्,
अम्, m. n. a shower of nectar or ambrosia.
—पी-
यूषवर्षाय, Nom. A. पीयूषवर्षायते, -यि-
तुम्, to become or turn into a shower of nectar.

2. पीयूष, Nom. P. पीयूषति, पीयूषितुम्, to
become or turn into nectar.
पीयूष 1. 2. पीयूष. See under पीन, col. 1.
पीय् 1. पीय् (a Sautra rt.), to gladden.

पीय् 2. पीय्, cl. 1. P. पीयति, &c., Ved.
to blame, abuse, treat disrespectfully or
with contempt; to give pleasure.

पीयक, अस्, m., Ved. ‘an abuser,’ (probably) N. of
a class of demons.
पीयत्नु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. scornful.
पीयूक्षा पीयूक्षा, f. a species of plant.
